command:
command -v source-snapshot || true
command -v fetch-source || true
command -v snapshot || true
compgen -c 2>/dev/null | sort -u | rg 'source|snapshot|fetch|review' | head -100
find /usr/local/bin /usr/bin -maxdepth 1 -type f -o -type l 2>/dev/null | rg 'source|snapshot|fetch|review' | head -100
